answer: An attacker running 144 aliases thus needs 55 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in vertex, expire in relic, and harbor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3197 identities would post 4188 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
